visual.name: smartvisualsNewspaper
visual.description: A newspaper front page written from your data. Bind a category, a measure and a period: the visual finds the stories (who leads, who pulled ahead, the biggest rise and fall, the total; records, streaks, unusual moves and the plan in Editor's desk), ranks them like an editor and prints headlines, decks and small charts in English, Spanish, Portuguese or German. Deterministic templates, offline, certified-ready. Part of the SmartVisuals family for Power BI.
